plain: To clear someone of blame or guilt

webster.text: To clear by words from a charge or imputation of fault or guilt; to excuse.

example.quote: I wish not to exculpate the states for their improper neglects in not paying their quotas of requisitions; but, in applying the remedy, we must be governed by reason and facts.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XVII, Jan. 23, 1788
